identityRule: type id = platform:metadataVersion[:assembly]:namespace.name; shortName only for presentation and for matching evidence keyed by short name (see sources.attributionRule)

nativeOdc.resolutionRule: a short type name written in the ODC metadata (bases, Create* return types, property types) is resolved, relative to the declaring type, among the candidates of the same generic arity, as: unique in the index > same namespace > enclosing namespace (C# looks a simple name up through the enclosing namespaces: OutSystems.Model.Data → OutSystems.Model) > module/extension context (candidates in OutSystems.Model.Extensions/ExternalLibraries describe extension modules, Verbs.cs:904-905: a module type resolves to the non-extension candidate and vice versa, when exactly one remains) > same assembly > ambiguous (recorded, not followed). Each resolved base/factory/reference carries its resolvedBy
nativeOdc.rule: kept: every interface (no de-duplication by short name) whose resolved base closure reaches IObject (role object) or IObjectSignature only (role signature); a base written as a short name is resolved by RESOLUTION_RULE, otherwise recorded in ambiguousBases and not followed (its members are not merged); role stated through an ambiguous base only when all candidates agree, else undetermined (kept, flagged); excluded: *Descriptor / IObjectDescriptor / IClassDescriptor closures, classes, static classes, enums, interfaces without the object roots (Extensions/ExternalLibraries hierarchies reach IModelObject only). Identity = platform:metadataVersion:assembly:namespace.name
nativeOdc.versionNote: metadata ODC 1.7.24.10718 (reflection index) against installed Studio 1.7.25.10762: the inventory is not complete for the installed version

nativeO11.rule: kept: every interface (no de-duplication) whose catalog Bases include OutSystems.Model.IObject (object) or IObjectSignature only (signature); excluded: *Descriptor and interfaces without those roots; names are qualified in the catalog (bases, creatables, property types), so no resolution ambiguity arises except for property types written as short names; the catalog has no method list (Delete/Duplicate assumed from IObject). Identity = platform:metadataVersion:namespace.name (assembly not recorded by the catalog)

sources.attributionRule: evidence keyed by a short name (jobs, ledger, descriptor, reader census) is attributed to a qualified type only when: exact = the short name has one qualified type in the platform inventory; kernel-rank (create only) = the kernel ranking of Verbs.cs FindCreateCore leaves one top candidate (NRWidgets > OutSystems.Model.* > Extensions/ExternalLibraries/Processes/BusinessProcesses); module-context = after removing the OutSystems.Model.Extensions and OutSystems.Model.ExternalLibraries candidates (extension-module types, "never what an eSpace creates", Verbs.cs:904-905) one candidate remains; otherwise ambiguous = recorded under the short name, attributed to no qualified type and not counted as proof
sources.kindClassRule: referenced-signature = role signature (base closure reaches IObjectSignature but not IObject); concrete-authorable = role object with a factory that returns exactly this type (ODC: Create* method resolved without ambiguity; O11: catalog Creatables) or, when no other inventoried interface has it as a base, a widget/flow-node interface created through the generic CreateWidget<T>/CreateNode<T>; base-interface = role object without such a factory that appears in the resolved base closure of another inventoried interface (its properties and operations are kept; it is not counted as an extra concrete element); undetermined = role object with neither a factory nor an implementer (possibly created by the platform, not verified). A concrete type that is also a base of others keeps alsoBaseOf
sources.appFamilyRule: tag from namespace/name: web = OutSystems.Model.UI.Web or Web*/IWeb* names; reactive = OutSystems.Model.UI.Mobile, NRWidgets plugin or Mobile*/IMobile* names; shared = the rest. A tag, not an exclusion: types tagged web stay in the inventory and in the per-kind denominators; the reader census tells whether ODC objects implement them

metadataRules.read: any inventoried interface: the reader lists objects by interface name (--kind matches implementers, inclusive for base interfaces); signatures are readable as referenced definitions
metadataRules.address: same as read: Kind:Name addressing resolves any interface name (Verbs.Implements matches short or full name)
metadataRules.usages: suggests when a writable property of another inventoried interface has the type (or its *Signature) as value type; consumers through expressions/text are invisible in metadata (no-basis, not negative)
metadataRules.create: suggests when a Create* method (ODC) / catalog Creatable (O11) returns exactly this type; suggests-generic for widgets (CreateWidget<T>, the parent decides); ambiguous when the factory return type is a short name shared by several types; context-excluded for referenced signatures (created in the producer module); otherwise no-basis
metadataRules.set: suggests when the interface declares a writable property; suggests-inherited when only inherited writable properties exist; context-excluded for referenced signatures even when their metadata lists writable properties (the consumer module cannot edit a referenced definition); no-basis otherwise
metadataRules.rename: suggests when Name is writable on the interface itself; suggests-inherited when Name is inherited; no-basis when Name is not writable (a writable Identifier is recorded as a precondition, not as rename); context-excluded for signatures. Writable Name does not by itself prove rename: the verb also refuses name clashes
metadataRules.replace: as usages (replace swaps references to a referenceable type)
metadataRules.move: suggests-inherited for model objects (IObject: a position in the parent ISequence / flow node position); it does not mean every context allows moving; context-excluded for signatures
metadataRules.duplicate: suggests-inherited for model objects (IObject.Duplicate inherited); the platform may refuse for some kinds; context-excluded for signatures
metadataRules.delete: suggests-inherited when IModelObject.Delete() is in the resolved closure (ODC) or assumed from IObject (O11, no method list); inherited Delete does not mean deletion is allowed (consumers block it unless force); context-excluded for signatures

sources.routeRule: reader = read/address through inspect (--kind/--name/--select); generic-verb = the verb table accepts the verb for any model object (a route for the kind, not a proof for the type); +contract = the JSON of api --op names the short name; contract = named without a generic verb; none = no verb covers the operation. codeMentions (expander source literals) and builderPrimitives (C# Authoring*.cs, ODC create) are hints, not public contracts
sources.exposureRule: exposure.capabilities (lane of the descriptor) = capabilities naming the short name, attributed by attributionRule; exposure.effective=false with reusePotential.sameShortNameInDescriptor on the other platform = reuse potential only, not exposure and not proof
sources.statusRule: context-excluded (signature edits) > tested-executed (ledger or census attributed to this qualified type) > tested-static (positive job attributed) > refused-proven (documented refusal or negative job without positive) > undetermined when evidence exists only under an ambiguous/other short name > route-only (metadata suggests + route, no proof) > suggested-only (no route) > undetermined (no basis)

operationalBoundary.rule: model = reads or changes the module model headless (inspect, job, discover, feature build); delivery = snapshot/candidate/merge/publish of a module; data = development database records; portal = ODC Portal APIs; operations = Studio session, diagnostics, URLs, tenants

families.rule: curated regular expressions over the short name (then namespace) — see FAMILY_RULES in the script

sameShortName.meaning: the same short name exists on both platforms (possibly in several namespaces each); a naming coincidence, not a contract

sameQualifiedName.meaning: same namespace.name on both platforms: a correspondence CANDIDATE; the contract (properties, factories, behaviour) is not verified by this level

sameQualifiedNameAndSameWritableProperti.meaning: metadata-level agreement of the writable property names (ODC own+inherited vs O11 catalog list, whose inheritance scope is not recorded); still not a proof of behaviour

verifiedContractEquivalence.meaning: requires a positive proof of the same operation with the same contract on both platforms; O11 has no executed ledger in this checkout, so nothing is verified
